description: The initiative is aimed at providing free training to one lakh students across the state in cutting-edge technologies like Artificial Intelligence (AI) and Cloud Computing.
body_lead: 1 lakh students to receive free AI and cloud computing training under Telangana initiative The initiative is aimed at providing free training to one lakh students across the state in cutting-edge technologies like Artificial Intelligence (AI) and Cloud Computing. By Newsmeter Network Hyderabad: In a major push toward tech-driven education, the Telangana government has launched the Telangana AI and Cloud Skilling Initiative.
